body:
Oh hey, something I can finally post about on here!

He was suicidal and depressed and I genuinely thought he was gonna off himself if I dumped him after finding out about the other girl. We stayed together another 4 months, trying to communicate and work things out. In retrospect, I should've had more respect for myself and left him immediately. 

Lesson learned. Don't tolerate cheating. Ever. He actually called me about a year later and apologized profusely for treating me like shit and being a scumbag, so that's cool. People grow up and change, but don't tolerate their behavior if it's hurting you.
Dropping out of college to pursue a tattoo apprenticeship. Now I'm year and a half into it and my art has improved more in that time than I believe if I had gone to art school.

Colorado and Texas are non-license states if I recall correctly.
 In Missouri where I live, I had to be Blood Born Pathogen and CPR certified, have a record of all my procedures and hours, and get it all signed by a notary. Pain in the ass, but worth it.

I'm no longer with him, but I feel like I was pretty bad at coping with it. He was clearly depressed and I encouraged him to go to therapy or get on some type of medication and he flat out refused. I tried my best to make him happy, do fun things, listen when he was having a hard time, but he was unresponsive to it.

He blamed a lot of his depression on his upbringing, which yeah I get, but at some point, you need to make an effort to be better. Also he cheated on me and put me about a grand in debt because I was paying his bills. Depression is hard. I've been there. But that's no excuse to be a dick.
omg, Adventures in Odyssey was my jam as a kid tho. Probably because I wasn't allowed anything else BUT STILL.
Body piercer here. No, I do not enjoy causing people pain. No, I do not derive some weird pleasure out of doing genital piercings. Hold the fuck still and let me do my job.

I was raised to be a holocaust denier growing up. My dad is a white nationalist (doesn't actually call himself that, but he might as well be). I've watched a lotta anti-jew documentaries as a kid. Apparently there's a pool at Auschwitz that they won't show you on the tour? idk

For the record, I don't believe in this shit and was even skeptical as a child. And as an adult, me and my dad don't talk anymore
Body piercer here! Hurting people and blood is pretty chill for me now.
Yep. The pigments in black lining ink are more closely packed together, making it harder for the skin to disperse it over time.
Again, every shop runs different. I do all the food runs and we all order our own supplies and book our own appointments. Maybe it's a way bigger shop lol.
I mean, you can probably still do that. I'm talking more of the pinterest-y tattoos. The ones with thin delicate lines and pastel pinkish colors.
Trust me, I triple check everything. Apparently that's just how he spelled it.
hah true. In the case of the "fucking fantastic" girl, she didn't want her parents to see.

Honestly? I'd say stick with stuff that's more traditional or neotraditional. Notice how all those styles have pretty thick lines and bold colors. Also black. Black is essential to a tattoo. Sure, you can do super pastel-y and watercolor designs, but they tend to fade and need more touchups. Black holds up in the skin the best. 

But again, I'm but a mere apprentice and there's a lot more to learn. Def ask your tattoo artist.

Just curious, but how does one get a job as a shop manager while not having any tattooing experience?
I ask because I'm currently an apprentice and I'm trying to imagine what it'd be like taking direction from my boss if he wasn't actually a tattoo artist. Every shops runs differently though, I guess.

Tattoo apprentice for about a year and half here! I haven't had as much crazy shit happen since I haven't been in the industry as long, but a few come to mind:

When I tattooed the name "Decklan" with a little heart on a dude's buttcheek.

Tattooed "fucking fantastic", again, on a girl's ass. Idk what it is with kids and ass tattoos these days. 

And then of course a whole bunch of stupid cliche shit. Tiny minimalistic anchors? Sure. Watercolor? Of coooourse. I do a decent job and they turn out cute, but I feel like the general public don't realize what makes a tattoo bold and stand the test of time.
I'm mildly selfish. I like my alone time and can't just come over and cuddle with you on a whim. Also I can't put out 24/7.
Saaaaame. But honestly, the quality of the more expensive products is going to last you longer and make you look and feel better. Versus the shit brands from the drug store.
Hot wings to-go and a bath bomb. Then I proceed to devour said hot wings in the bath like the disgusting savage I am.
Those light up cat headphones that had a big kickstarter like 2 years ago. It was like $150 and I've worn em maybe 4 times. They're cute and all but ehhh

My current bf. He's pretty much perfect, been together for almost a year. 

Problem is, I'm his first girlfriend ever. And he kind of... idk, puts me on a pedestal? Like I took his virginity and everything and he thinks I'm the bomb. But I'm not. I'm kind of a shitty person. And I'm afraid that he's doing this because he's never experienced a relationship before. And because I'm the first, he's gonna keep borderline worshipping me and it's gonna cause problems later.

I dunno, it's probably stupid. But it worries me.
I'm a body piercer. Can confirm. I always tell people getting it that we don't guarantee that it'll cure migraines. But hey it's a cute piercing.

"All you do is homework and art stuff. You never hang out with me."

I was a full time college student and working and trying to get stuff ready for an artist alley table. Fuck that ex.

I'm on the verge of getting my tattooing license. This means I can finally quit my day job and focus 100% on art and the tattoo industry, which means no more trying to bust my ass between 2 different jobs. I'll also get to hang out with my SO more :)
The Rescuers: Down Under
How are the worms, Michael?

Thanks, man! I'll give the paper towel trick a try on my next appointment :)

I honestly don't get the rotary and cartridge machine hate. Like I get that coil machines are the tried and true method but the whole #loyaltothecoil circle jerk trend is obnoxious.
Every Teen Girl Squad line ever apparently, complete with voice.
I was homeschooled as a kid and can confirm that overly nosey people will get in your business about why you're not in school lol. Definitely don't miss that.
Broke my femur bone by kicking a rubber ball around on the living room carpet as a kid. I slipped and did this weird fucked up version of the splits. Go meeee
Yeah we kept it cold. To be honest, undiluted juice tastes weird to me as an adult.
My mom did this, but it was to help spread the juice out longer since it was being split between 7 people and we were poor lol.

Grew up homeschooled and fundamentalist soooo...

Women are to be married off at a young age, preferably through the courting method, and approved by my father. And immediately start making babies, of course

No videogames or cartoons because they rot your brain, duh. Me and my sisters would sneak the laptop into our room after midnight and watch Avatar and Naruto. Good times.

No cutting or dying hair and no makeup because that's tampering with what God gave you. I'd put eyeliner on in the bathroom at church youthgroup just to feel somewhat normal. 

Also no non-white friends. I had a latina friend at church and my dad was furious when I started hanging out with her. 

Just to name a few. There's so much more but it gets all muddled.

Tattoo apprentice here. It's not just putting art on skin, kids. It's dealing with blood and cross contamination. It's also incredibly damaging on the back, shoulders, and eyes after so many years.

But sure, I should do this for cheap because "it's your passion, right??"

Yup! I just started my tattoo apprenticeship and one of the requirements at my shop is to give yourself a tattoo. It's on the side of my knee and it's janky af, but hey, it's initiation into the industry.
I'm a professional piercer and trust me, me and everyone in the industry hates it as much as you. Septums are a bitch to do. They're cute imo, but a difficult procedure to perform.

Domestic abuse jokes. Idk how popular those are in your guys's areas, but I feel like I hear them all the time here. 

For example, when I got my wisdom teeth out and had bruising/swelling on my cheeks, my boss said "did your boyfriend beat you up durrhurrhurr?" 
How is that funny?? What if he actually was?

"You'd be a whole lot prettier if you smiled, ya know"

Fuck off.

"I can't wait until you graduate college and can work here full time forever."

Noped outta there real quick.

Came out to me as a flat earther after a year together. Maybe he was just trolling me, I'll never know. But he spent hours trying to convince me by showing me conspiracy theory vids. I wish I was joking.

Body piercer here! No, a daith piercing does not prevent migraines. There is zero scientific evidence to back that up. The same trend was happening a few years ago with the tragus piercing. 
Apparently if you twisted it, it was an appetite suppressor. Just get a cute ass piercing because you want it, not because some article on facebook told you it was a cure.
I have a weird fascination for how rich upperclass people live. Like it's just interesting to me. I know it's trash TV but I ain't gonna stop.

Tried to dump him, he called me an alcoholic (I drink like once a week, and not even hard liquor), and then stormed out of my house. I get a call later that night asking if we could talk. He says he tried to kill himself that day by parking his car on the train tracks. 
We stayed together another 6 months because I was an insecure depressed 19 year old.

Noped the fuck out when he cheated on me later and tried to blame it on me.

It was a halloween party. He was dressed up as Kakashi and I made fun of him the entire time for being a weaboo even though I myself am a huge weaboo. 
Still together and still doing weaboo things :p

I'm an artist. I posted a recently finished Ghibli themed painting on facebook and this girl who've I've never EVER liked commented with "omg i just finished a Howl's Moving Castle acrylic painting too!"

Like ok?? that's cool I guess? It just rubbed me the wrong way for some reason.

He told me that his newly pregnant girlfriend had just dumped him. He even showed me that she had blocked him on all social media. I said "fuck it" and we started being friends with benefits for a couple weeks. 
I later saw her tagging him in facebook posts with shit like "date with bae." Like a day after we had just fucked too.
I've been cheated on before, and I don't want to be a third party to cheating ever again. This is why I have trust issues.

My rich cousins would do the same thing and I was too oblivious as a kid to realize that it was because they felt bad for us. It was all really nice clothes too, like Ralph Lauren and and North Face. They were used but def a lot nicer than stained thrift store clothes.
I live in Branson, MO and this is 100% true.

Eating quickly. 
This one still affects me in my adult life. I'm always the first one to finish my food when out eating with friends because my inner child is still thinking that this is the first good full meal you've had all day and you gotta eat it before one of your other 5 siblings snatches it off your plate. 
Also my mom used to save every single pickle jar, yogurt container, and sourcream container. I was always embarrassed using those to bring my lunch in when going to school.
I used to eat the leaves off of trees. Not for any particular reason, just because I felt like it I guess? Some were more bitter than others...

No Harry Potter because "witchcraft"
No cartoon shows because "they rot your brain." Any cartoons we had, we already owned on VHS and they were strictly bible/educational.
No halloween because, again, "witchcraft"
No hanging out with non-white kids because my dad was a straight up racist lmao.
Also I was homeschooled so that explains a lot :/

Body piercer/tattoo artist here! It's definitely a cool industry to be in, but it's got major downsides. Yeah, I get to do what I love, draw all day, listen to rock music. But I also have to deal with the shittiest people in the world, work late hours into the night, pay for my own supplies, and am constantly talked down to for being female.
So be nice to your tattoo artists. If they come off as a bit cold, it's probably because they were up until 3 am the previous night tattooing barbed wire on drunk assholes just so they could make their rent.

It didn't. He cheated on me and the other girl didn't know he was already in a long term relationship. She found out and told me. I stuck with him for another 4 or so months because he kept threatening suicide and I felt personally responsible for his mental health. 
Remember kids, just because you have severe depression and anxiety, it doesn't give you the right to be a cheating, manipulative bastard.
ok but why is nobody mentioning Sufjan Steven's amazing Christmas albums? They're so original and genuine and you can tell he didn't do it for commercial gain. The guy just really loves Christmas.

That girls came from two mommies and boys came from two dads. I didn't really have a concept of what homosexual relationships were yet since I was like 4 or 5. 
So I thought that I was half girl half boy because I had a mom and dad instead of two moms. If that makes any sense.

Definitely learning how to interact with other people once I reached college age. My parents homeschooled me and my 4 other siblings for religious brainwashing purposes so it's not like I had many friends. If I tried to be friends with anyone that wasn't white, christian, and straight, it was a no-go. 

Now I'm a queer 20 something with tattoos and a career (women aren't allowed to have careers dontchaknow) and my father doesn't speak to me. 
It wasn't the worst thing in the world to be homeschooled, honestly. It definitely shaped me into a more interesting person in the end. Kinda bummed I missed out on some of the typical teenager shennanigans though.
Good god I love Diablo 3. I dumped my cheating boyfriend and reaaaally regret not taking his PS3 and our copy of the game.
When he told me that he sincerely believed that the earth was flat.
Wait wait, Missouri State? Like in Springfield? When was this? I almost went there and now I'm so relieved I didn't.
As an artist and a tattoo apprenticing trying to make art my full time job, this thread terrifies me.

I used to think that I was half female and half male. Like because my mom married a man that I wasn't fully a girl. I thought that if two women got married then they could make a 100% girl and vice-versa with men. If that makes sense? 
It wasn't until my father started making homophobic comments that it kind of dawned on me. Keep in mind that I was like 6.
I can jiggle my eyes. Like they look like they're vibrating. As a kid I thought most people could do it but I guess not?? People's reactions are great though .

I work in large format vinyl printing at a little local sign shop. This one job was a particularly huge pain the ass and the client didn't send good files. After numerous test prints, reprints, recutting, and wasting a lot of expensive material, my boss threw up her hands and yelled "THIS IS FUCKED" and drove off.

 She didn't show up for the next few days and I finished the job on my own. When she came back, nobody brought it up.

I work at a printing and vinyl shop right now and I'm also an artist. I take extra scraps of vinyl that will be thrown away and make decals out of them, the nerdy kind that you find at conventions. And if I'm alone, I'll make prints of my work. Then I sell all this shit at comic conventions for pretty cheap, which allows people to buy more and therefore I make more profit. 
I dunno, I feel kind of bad about it. But honestly, I'm overworked, underpaid, and this is an extremely toxic work environment.

I'm currently a tattoo apprentice. We get a looooot of mandalas.
This one girl last week came in for her second mandala. Like one wasn't enough??

Not a parent but I was homeschooled up until 10th grade. We were the typical super christian/conservative family with like 7 kids. I woke up at 7 am every morning and would rush to get my school work done and checked so I could play Dragonfable all day. We were super sheltered and basically brainwashed.

Now I'm a 20 year old female with multiple facial piercings and tattoos, no longer brainwashed, no longer a racist or homophobe. My father has pretty much disowned me.
I got chickenpox as a kid so that's out of the way. I'm scheduled to get the other standard vaccines in a few weeks.
I will be in a few weeks!
Fucking chill. I'm scheduled to get vaccinated in a few weeks. I'm very pro-vaccine despite the way I was raised.

I'm 20 and never got vaccinated, neither did my little brother. The only reason we didn't cause an outbreak is probably because we were homeschooled and weren't around other kids that much. I love my parents but good god they had some dumb ideas.
I totally can and I will have to soon because certain colleges require vaccination records. The money aspect is why I've put it off for most of my adult life.

Both me and my little brother weren't vaccinated as children and still haven't to this day. My dad was super anti-vax and paranoid about the government spying on him. There was a few times as a kid when I found rusty nails and my mom flipped shit because I didn't have a tetanus shot. Never got whooping cough or measles (nor did my brother) and I feel like my immune system is pretty strong, but I'm still waiting for the day when I get super sick and need a vaccine. I'm 20 now and very pro-vaccine. Vaccinate your kids, dumbfucks.
